title: Webhook notification for new open questions
description: Raised in grilling (HANDOVER §4). For tooling that supports it (e.g. T3 webhook tasks): POST to a URL configured in board.json when a question is posted. The stderr notice and questions command cover the base case. Depends on Q&A.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Design grilled (config, payload, secret/signing, failure handling)
CLI and bridge post on new questions; tests
